risk_description: The gearbox may be faulty. Forces and vibrations may occur when driving, which could damage the gear-shift linkage and the gearbox could  disconnect from the drive shaft, causing the vehicle to lose propulsion. Moreover, components could detach from the vehicle, posing a risk to other road users.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
